relations.subject: Michael Eido Luetchford
relations.evidence: Michael Eido Luetchford was born in Dewsbury, England in October 1944, and graduated from the University of Bradford in 1967 with a degree in Electronic Engineering.

relations.subject: Michael Eido Luetchford
relations.evidence: In 1977 he went to work in Japan, where he met his wife, Yoko, and they both became students of Gudo Nishijima Roshi, receiving the Dharma transmission in 1990.

relations.subject: Michael Eido Luetchford
relations.evidence: Michael started to edit and publish the teachings and translations of Nishijima Roshi.

relations.subject: Michael Eido Luetchford
relations.evidence: This was eventually to result in the setting up of Windbell Publications, which has published a 4-volume translation of Dogen Zenji's Shobogenzo.
